group: hashCode - both entry and exit are null

cases.description: A Position with no entry and no exit should return the hash code computed by Objects.hash(null, null). This verifies that the method correctly handles null fields.
A Position with a non‑null entry Trade (hashCode() == 10) and a null exit should return the hash code computed by Objects.hash(entry, null) which equals 1271.
When the entry Trade object's hashCode() method throws a RuntimeException, Position.hashCode() should propagate that exception.
